description: This Java class 'ShippingPackagingController' is a Spring MVC controller responsible for handling HTTP requests related to shipping packaging configuration in an e-commerce or shipping management system. It includes methods for displaying the shipping packaging configuration page and saving configuration changes, interacting with the shipping service layer and managing model data for views.

classes.name: ShippingPackagingController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing shipping packaging configurations, including displaying the configuration form and saving user changes.

methods.name: displayShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles GET request to display current shipping packaging configuration, initializing default values if none exist.

methods.name: saveShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles POST request to save updated shipping packaging configuration, formatting input values and persisting changes.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the menu context for the view, highlighting the current section.
